His humorous remark lightened the tense atmosphere.

The news lightened his mood.

As the war debt lightened, the economy of the country developed quickly.

I don't know what had lost her her job.

Two ships were lost in the storm.

She lost her son in the crowd.

They lost themselves in the strange city.
